metadata.title: The Calabi-Yau and Sullivan conjectures for minimal surfaces with symmetries
metadata.abstract: Let \(G\) be a finite group acting on a connected open Riemann surface \(X\) by holomorphic automorphisms and acting on a Euclidean space \(\mathbb R^n\), \(n\ge 3\), by orthogonal transformations. In a previous paper, the second author gave a necessary and sufficient condition for the existence of a \(G\)-equivariant conformal minimal immersion \(F:X\to\mathbb R^n\), and he asked whether such \(F\) can be chosen to be a proper map. Assuming that this condition holds, we give an affirmative answer when \(X\) is a bordered Riemann surface and \(G\) acts freely on the boundary of \(X\). This contributes to the Sullivan conjecture concerning the existence of proper hyperbolic minimal surfaces in \(\mathbb R^3\) of finite topology. Under the same conditions, we also construct a \(G\)-equivariant proper conformal minimal immersion of \(X\) to the unit ball of \(\mathbb R^n\) which is complete in the induced metric, thereby opening a new direction in the Calabi--Yau theory regarding the study of complete bounded minimal surfaces. Analogous results hold for null curves in \(\mathbb C^n\).

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 在有限群等变条件下，构造带边 Riemann 曲面内部到欧氏空间的 proper 共形极小浸入，以及到单位球的完备 proper 浸入。
techniques: 开放 Riemann 曲面方法
analysis.breakthrough: 在既有存在性判据成立、群在边界自由作用时，肯定回答 proper 性问题，并给出有界完备极小曲面的对称版本；另推广到 null 曲线。
analysis.limitations: 需有限群、带边曲面及边界自由作用等条件；proper 到单位球与 proper 到整个欧氏空间不同，也不能统称为任意拓扑和任意群作用下解决全部 Calabi–Yau 或 Sullivan 猜想。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者将数学思想、陈述和证明归于本人，披露生成式 AI（主要 GPT 6.1 Sol）用于正确性和完整性核验及语言编辑。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.31847v1 · PDF 第 27 页 Declaration on the use of AI

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者将数学思想、陈述和证明归于本人，披露生成式 AI（主要 GPT 6.1 Sol）用于正确性和完整性核验及语言编辑。

analysis.priorityReason: 对称约束下极小曲面存在性与完备性的新方向。
